headlines.shortLinkText: Brees, Watson in sync to deal Falcons first loss

headlines.description: Andy Dalton threw three touchdown passes and the unbeaten Cincinnati Bengals won their sixth straight to match the team's best start to a season with a 34-21 victory over the Buffalo Bills on Sun
headlines.shortLinkText: Dalton helps Bengals stay perfect with 34-21 win over Bills

headlines.shortLinkText: Manning shakes off interceptions, Broncos beat Browns 26-23

headlines.description: Matt Prater kicked a 27-yard field goal with 2:29 left in overtime, and the Detroit Lions beat the Chicago Bears 37-34 on Sunday for their first victory of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions top Bears 37-34 on FG with 2:29 left in OT for 1st win

headlines.description: Cameron Wake got his first four sacks this season and also forced two fumbles -- all in the first half -- and the Miami Dolphins routed the Tennessee Titans 38-10 on Sunday in Dan Campbell's debu
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins rout Titans 38-10 in Dan Campbell's coaching debut

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Minnesota's defense and rookie wide receiver Stefon Diggs bailed out Teddy Bridgewater for an erratic performance, and the Vikings held on to beat the mistake-prone Kansas City Chiefs 16-10 on Su
headlines.shortLinkText: Vikings hold on for ugly 16-10 win vs Chiefs

events.name: Washington Redskins at New York Jets

headlines.description: Ryan Fitzpatrick threw two touchdown passes and ran for another score, and the New York Jets overcame a sloppy first half to beat the banged-up Washington Redskins 34-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fitzpatrick, Ivory lead Jets to 34-20 victory over Redskins

headlines.description: Landry Jones threw two touchdown passes to Martavis Bryant in relief of Michael Vick and the Pittsburgh Steelers rallied for a 25-13 win over the Arizona Cardinals on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers rally behind backup Jones, stun Cardinals 25-13

headlines.description: Brian Hoyer threw three touchdown passes on third down, two to DeAndre Hopkins, and the Houston Texans beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 31-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hoyer, Hopkins help Texans handle Jaguars, 31-20

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw a 26-yard touchdown pass to Greg Olsen with 32 seconds left and the Carolina Panthers remained unbeaten, rallying for a stunning 27-23 win over the Seattle Seahawks on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton leads late Carolina rally for 27-23 win over Seattle

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: The Green Bay Packers stopped San Diego on fourth-and-goal from the 3 with 15 seconds left and overcame a career day by Philip Rivers to hold off the Chargers 27-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers hold off pass-happy Chargers for 27-20 win

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick completed a 76-yard touchdown pass to ex-Ravens star Torrey Smith, Joe Flacco threw two interceptions and the San Francisco 49ers beat Baltimore 25-20 on Sunday to snap a four-ga
headlines.shortLinkText: Kaepernick throws 2 TD passes as 49ers snap four-game skid

events.name: New England Patriots at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for 312 yards and three touchdowns and New England took advantage of a botched fake punt in the Patriots' 34-27 victory over the Indianapolis Colts on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady lifts Pats by Colts for best start in 8 years

events.name: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

headlines.description: DeMarco Murray ran for 109 yards and a touchdown, Nolan Carroll II returned one of Eli Manning's two interceptions for a score, and the Philadelphia Eagles beat the New York Giants 27-7.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles rout Giants for share of NFC East lead
